outcomes.symptom: Every region is a different network, a different ISP, and a months-long provision.
outcomes.outcome: Connect offices, clouds, and partners on one Global Fabric.

proof.metric: Time to stand up a new site or cloud path
proof.before: Separate circuits, contracts, and operating models per region
proof.after: On-demand NaaS, DIA, and ICR under one BT relationship

outcomes.symptom: Users, branches, and SaaS no longer live on one network — VPN and a perimeter firewall do not.
outcomes.outcome: Secure access from anywhere — SASE with a chosen SSE on Global Fabric.

proof.metric: Path from user to inspection to application
proof.before: Hairpinned internet into a single vendor SSE
proof.after: SD-WAN plus Cisco, Fortinet, Netskope, or Zscaler, peered on Global Fabric

outcomes.symptom: Calling, meetings, and numbers are three estates — and a fourth when the UC platform changes.
outcomes.outcome: One voice layer under Webex, with room to mix Teams or Zoom.

proof.before: Number ports, downtime, and a new voice contract
proof.after: Global Voice and UC Edge; Webex Calling or One Cloud Cisco on top

outcomes.symptom: Network, voice, and security each have a toolset and a ticket queue.
outcomes.outcome: One operating model — Ops Fabric across connectivity, voice, and security.

proof.before: Separate NOCs and no shared automation
proof.after: Observability, AI, and domain experts on Ops Fabric
